address: 26 Queen Street, Maidenhead, SL6 1HZ, United Kingdom
bio: What started out as a produce shop has morphed into a bright and airy restaurant, which is run with a lovely personal touch by Chef-Owner Wesley as he cooks at an on-view island kitchen. As its name and history suggests, seasonal ingredients are the foundation of the cooking, put front and centre in assured, colourful dishes that carry an appealing clarity of flavour. Regular supper evenings offer tasting menus inspired by the produce of the moment, while they still offer the 'dine at home' boxes they've done since day one....
